notes.title: Chapter 4 Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Fixed an error with baby dolls found in Chapter 4, and
Fixed an issue where you could go where you shouldn't.
(This bug caused the character to move out of the camera view)

Thank you.

notes.title: Chapter 1 Puzzle Hints Added Patch
notes.content:
Thank you for your interest in and play of Goodnight, Sweetie.
We've noticed that the puzzle elements in the current game are difficult to understand.
We hope that adding special effects will help solve these elements.

We've also fixed a blockage in certain rooms in Chapter 4 due to opaque walls and standardized the initial gamma adjustment across the board. 

Thanks again for your feedback.
